inputs.name: controllerFiles.name
inputs.description: The name is converted to PascalCase for the controller class and kebab-case for the generated file and test names. Those derived values are embedded in returned paths and source text; this function applies no additional validation.

inputs.name: classFiles.folder
inputs.description: The folder value is inserted directly into the src/ and test/ paths without transformation. This function applies no additional validation.

inputs.name: classFiles.name
inputs.description: The name is converted to PascalCase for the class and kebab-case for the generated file and test names. Those derived values are embedded in returned paths and source text; this function applies no additional validation.

inputs.name: classFiles.suffix
inputs.description: The suffix is appended directly to the PascalCase name to form the generated class name. It does not affect the kebab-case file name, and this function applies no additional validation.

inputs.name: repositoryFiles.name
inputs.description: The name is converted to PascalCase for the repository class and kebab-case for the generated file and test names. Those derived values are embedded in returned paths and source text; this function applies no additional validation.

inputs.name: adapterFiles.name
inputs.description: The name is converted to PascalCase for the adapter class and kebab-case for the generated file and fallback connection name. Those derived values are embedded in returned paths and source text; this function applies no additional validation.

inputs.name: validatorFiles.name
inputs.description: The name is converted to PascalCase for the validator class and kebab-case for the generated file and test names. Those derived values are embedded in returned paths and source text; this function applies no additional validation.

inputs.name: serializerFiles.name
inputs.description: The name is converted to PascalCase for the serializer class and kebab-case for the generated file and test names. Those derived values are embedded in returned paths and source text; this function applies no additional validation.

inputs.name: policyFiles.name
inputs.description: The name is converted to PascalCase for the policy class and kebab-case for the generated file and test names. Those derived values are embedded in returned paths and source text; this function applies no additional validation.

inputs.name: seederFiles.name
inputs.description: The name is converted to PascalCase for the seed function and kebab-case for the generated file and test names. Those derived values are embedded in returned paths and source text; this function applies no additional validation.

inputs.name: utilFiles.name
inputs.description: The name is converted to camelCase for the utility function and kebab-case for the generated file and test names. Those derived values are embedded in returned paths and source text; this function applies no additional validation.

outputs.name: controllerFiles
outputs.description: Returns the controller source and its Vitest test as path/content records. The records are plans only; this function does not write either file.

outputs.name: classFiles
outputs.description: Returns a class source file and its Vitest instance test as path/content records under the supplied folder. The generated run method returns the kebab-case name; the records are plans only and are not written.

outputs.name: repositoryFiles
outputs.description: Returns a generic repository source file and its Vitest instance test as path/content records. The generated repository keeps records in a Map keyed by numeric id and provides find and save; this function does not persist files or records.

outputs.name: adapterFiles
outputs.description: Returns an adapter source file and its Vitest instance test as path/content records. The generated connect method uses config.name when present and otherwise the kebab-case input name; the records are plans only.

outputs.name: validatorFiles
outputs.description: Returns a validator source file and its Vitest instance test as path/content records. The generated validator reports an error only when the input has no own enumerable keys; it does not validate field contents.

outputs.name: serializerFiles
outputs.description: Returns a serializer source file and its Vitest instance test as path/content records. The generated serialize method returns a shallow copy of the input object, so nested values are not copied.

outputs.name: policyFiles
outputs.description: Returns a policy source file and its Vitest instance test as path/content records. The generated canRead method returns true only when actor.role is exactly admin.

outputs.name: seederFiles
outputs.description: Returns a seed-data source file and its Vitest test as path/content records. The generated async function resolves to an object containing the kebab-case name as seeded metadata; it does not seed a database.

outputs.name: utilFiles
outputs.description: Returns a utility source file and its Vitest test as path/content records. The generated function applies String.trim, which removes surrounding whitespace but leaves internal whitespace unchanged.
